ORIGINAL COASTER GROVE GAME PRODUCTION ASSETS. Authentic late-1990s PC theme-park management-game PIXEL ART, hand-placed coarse pixel clusters and crisp stair-step edges, restrained saturated indexed-color appearance. These are functional tiny on-map game sprites, NOT illustrations, not concept art, not 3D renders, not miniature toys, not smooth vector art. Light from upper left expressed ONLY as two or three solid palette shades per material. NO gradients, NO antialiasing, NO ambient occlusion, NO bloom, NO texture, NO soft lighting, NO shadows on ground, NO text, NO labels, NO borders, NO grid lines. Entire background perfectly uniform saturated MAGENTA #FF00FF, including gaps and holes. Objects fully separate. Every cell has at least 12 percent empty margin. Isometric orthographic 2:1 projection: each ground-edge runs 2 screen pixels horizontally for 1 vertically, camera elevation 26.565 degrees, azimuth45 degrees. No perspective convergence. Ground contact anchor centered horizontally near bottom of each cell. No attached terrain, diamond ground tiles, grass squares, pavement, scenery, decorative bases, scenery plinths or display platforms. Include only an object's actual necessary structure.
SINGLE exact atlas layout: FOUR equal columns by THREE equal rows, twelve equal SQUARE cells, 4:3 overall image. Each cell contains exactly one complete isolated object. Match style between all objects. Work as if each cell is a 128x128 logical-pixel canvas enlarged nearest-neighbor; visible square pixel clusters should be roughly 4x4 output pixels, with relatively simple silhouettes and low detail. For buildings aim about64x56 logical pixels; taller rides about86x96 logical pixels; small props around32x32 logical pixels. Leave more empty magenta around smaller objects, do not enlarge bench and shrubs to ride size. Palette: grass green, dark spruce, cream, muted golden wood, coral red and turquoise/teal. Dark tasteful outlines, crisp modest highlights.
